title: JavaScript Certification Test (2.1 & 2.2)
instructions: You have only one chance to attempt this test. Once submitted, it cannot be retaken.

questions.text: A developer is building a financial calculator where the value of taxRate must remain constant throughout the entire program execution. Other variables may change during calculations. Which variable declaration approach best enforces this requirement and prevents accidental reassignment?

A development team is refactoring older JavaScript code that uses function scoped variables. They want to modernize the code so that variables exist only inside the block where they are declared. Which keyword should replace most of the legacy declarations?

A student writes a program where a variable is declared but no value is assigned before it is logged to the console. The developer wants to understand what JavaScript will automatically assign to that variable at runtime.

An application needs to explicitly represent that a database record exists but currently has no value assigned to a field. The developer intentionally sets the variable to represent absence of value rather than an uninitialized state.

During debugging, a developer wants to confirm whether a variable currently stores a number, string, or boolean value. Which JavaScript operator should be used to inspect the data type of the variable?
While testing a program, a developer evaluates typeof null and notices the result appears unexpected compared with other primitive types. What value will JavaScript return in this situation?

A web form collects numeric input but the data arrives as text because it is entered by the user. The developer must convert the string value 45.67 into a numeric value while preserving the decimal portion.
A system processes inventory quantities that must always be stored as integers. The input arrives as the string value 120.75 and the decimal portion should be ignored during conversion.
An application receives user input and must determine whether the provided value represents a valid number before performing calculations. Which function best detects values that are not numeric?
A developer evaluates isNaN('Hello') while validating form input. What will the function return because the value cannot be converted into a number?
A financial dashboard displays product prices and must always show exactly two digits after the decimal point even when rounding is required. Which number method is most appropriate?
A scientific application must round values to a specified number of significant digits instead of a fixed number of decimal places. Which JavaScript method should be used?

An international e commerce platform wants to display product prices formatted according to regional currency settings such as commas and currency symbols. Which method best supports this formatting requirement?
A developer needs to display the message Hello Musa using a variable named name and modern JavaScript syntax that supports embedded expressions inside strings. Which technique should be used?

A security audit identifies a section of code where a string containing user input is passed directly into a function that executes it as JavaScript code. Which function likely caused this vulnerability?
A developer wants to store a list of student names in a single variable instead of creating separate variables for each name. Which data structure is most appropriate for this task?
A programmer creates an array containing three fruit names and needs to access the second item. Considering JavaScript indexing rules, which index should be used?
An application dynamically adds a new item to the end of a shopping list stored in an array. Which method should be used to perform this operation?
A music playlist application removes the most recently added track when the user clicks an undo button. Which array method performs this action?
A developer needs to add a high priority task to the beginning of an existing task list stored in an array. Which method should be used?
An application processes a queue of customer requests where the earliest request must be removed first. Which array method removes the first element from the list?
A developer must locate the position of the item Banana within an array of fruit names before removing it. Which method returns the index of that value?
After determining the index of a specific item in an array, the developer removes exactly one element from that position without affecting the rest of the list. Which method allows this modification?
A developer wants to copy the first three elements from an array while leaving the original array unchanged. Which method is designed for this purpose?
A program stores a list of student names and needs to arrange them alphabetically for display. Which method performs this operation?
A developer needs to invert the order of elements in an existing array so that the last element becomes the first. Which method performs this action?
A system checks whether a particular product name already exists in an array before adding a duplicate entry. Which method returns a boolean indicating the presence of the value?
A developer is creating a two dimensional grid to represent seats in a classroom where rows and columns must be accessed individually. Which data structure best represents this layout?
Given a two dimensional array named matrix, a developer accesses matrix[1][2]. What does this expression represent?
While debugging an application, a developer notices incorrect results when sorting numbers using the default sort method. What is the primary reason this issue occurs?
A developer wants to correctly sort numeric values inside an array. Which approach ensures numbers are compared mathematically instead of alphabetically?
A developer reviews a colleague's code where arrays store strings, numbers, and objects together without clear purpose. Why is this practice often discouraged in professional codebases?
A developer logs typeof username where username stores the value Ali. What result should appear in the console?
A variable called price stores the value 12.3456 and must be displayed with exactly two decimal places for billing purposes. What will be the resulting formatted value using toFixed(2)?
A developer formats the number 123.456 using toPrecision(4). What is the most accurate representation based on four significant digits?
A developer converts the string 123 into a number using Number('123'). What type will typeof return for the resulting value?
A developer converts a number variable into a string using the toString method. What is the primary purpose of this operation?

An application attempts to perform calculations using values obtained from user input fields which always arrive as text. Why must explicit type conversion be performed before mathematical operations?
options: Text input may cause incorrect arithmetic

questions.text: A developer writes code that dynamically evaluates mathematical expressions stored as strings using eval. What is the main reason modern development practices discourage this approach?
A developer defines an empty array that will later store product names retrieved from an API. Which syntax correctly creates this empty array?
A developer checks the total number of elements stored in an array named items. Which property should be used?

A developer copies part of an array into a new variable but accidentally modifies the original data because the wrong method was used. Which method should have been chosen to avoid modifying the original array?
A team designs a playlist feature where songs can be appended to the end of the list and removed from the end when the user presses undo. Which two methods are most appropriate for this behavior?
A developer wants to check whether the array fruits already contains the value Mango before adding it again. Which method returns a boolean indicating presence of the value?
